description: This file defines CMake functions and macros for retrieving the length of properties associated with maps and strings within a CMake build configuration.

methods.name: map_property_length
methods.description: Returns the length of a specified property within a map by attempting to retrieve the property and measuring the length of its value.

methods.name: map_property_string_length
methods.description: Returns the length of a string property associated with a map by retrieving the property and measuring its string length.
